description: Defines the HalController class for managing connection and communication with the Vibrator HAL service in Android, including connection handling, retries, and info retrieval.

classes.name: HalController
classes.description: Manages connection to the Vibrator HAL, handles retries, and provides info retrieval.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Connects to the latest available HAL version, possibly waiting for service availability.

methods.name: tryReconnect
methods.description: Reloads the HAL service instance without waiting, attempting rapid reconnection.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information from the connected HAL, with fallback to default info.

methods.name: doWithRetry
methods.description: Executes a HAL function with automatic retries on failure.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Internal template method that applies a HAL function with retry logic and logging.
